convention: each key -> dict[key] = {th,en,zh,ar} ALL = the verbatim 'th' below (glyph-exact). No translation sourced.

blockers.th: status-enum labels — PM_STATUS (ตามแผน/ใกล้ถึงกำหนด/เกินกำหนด, pm.jsx:33-36), PMWO_STATUS (รอดำเนินการ/กำลังดำเนินการ/เกินกำหนด/เสร็จสิ้น, pm.jsx:55-58), PMC_STATUS (ใช้งาน/ใกล้หมดอายุ/รอต่ออายุ, pm.jsx:68-71)
blockers.issue: These are defined OUTSIDE the R2 components and render dynamically via st.l (StatusBadge). They are NOT pm.* keys — they belong in a shared status-enum i18n surface. NOTE several DUPLICATE static keys minted this round (e.g. static tab pm.tabOpen 'รอดำเนินการ' vs dynamic PMWO_STATUS.open 'รอดำเนินการ'; static pm.tabOverdue/pm.legendOverdue 'เกินกำหนด' vs PM_STATUS/PMWO_STATUS overdue 'เกินกำหนด'). Decide whether the sacred round should also mint the shared status keys or defer to a separate status-enum round; if deferred, the static UI keys above stand and the status map is wired separately.

Hardcoded acronym 'SLA' prefix inside the fully-dynamic drill-down line `{cycle} · SLA {sla} · {start} – {end}`. Did NOT mint a separate key — porter should reuse pm.sla inline or keep as a language-neutral literal. Flagged as porter judgment, not a blocker to the i18n round.

blockers.th: มิถุนายน 2569 (PMCalendar default title param, pm2.jsx:552)
blockers.issue: Hardcoded default prop that is a Buddhist-era month/year DATE. Classified DYNAMIC (no key) per dates-are-dynamic rule, but it is a literal default (not from a data array). Port MUST feed the calendar header from date state, not an i18n key. Same PMCalendar/PMUpcoming default params (pm.upcomingTitle 'แผนที่จะถึง') ARE keyed because they are real UI copy; only the month/year is a date.

notes: Verified all 215 keys byte-for-byte against pototype/pm.jsx (dashboard+assets), pm2.jsx (contracts+schedule), pm3.jsx (work orders). CRITICAL FIXES over raw extractions: (1) KEY-NAME COLLISIONS resolved — extractors independently minted pm.pageTitle (4 different strings across dash/contracts/schedule/wo), pm.subtitle (4 different strings), pm.toastCreated (contracts 'สร้างสัญญา {no} แล้ว' vs wo 'สร้างใบงาน {no} แล้ว'), and pm.toastWoCreated (assets 'สร้างใบงาน PM สำหรับ {id} แล้ว' vs wo). Since all pm.* share ONE global dict, these would silently clobber. Renamed to pm.dashPageTitle/contractsPageTitle/schedulePageTitle/woPageTitle, pm.dashSubtitle/scheduleSubtitle/woSubtitle (assets already used pm.assetsSubtitle/contractsSubtitle stayed), pm.toastContractCreated, pm.toastAssetWoCreated (wo keeps pm.toastWoCreated). (2) CROSS-SCREEN DEDUP — 'PM · บำรุงรักษา' had 3 proposed names (breadcrumbPm/breadcrumbSection/breadcrumbRoot) → unified pm.breadcrumbRoot (5 screens); 'ใบงาน PM' dashboard nav-button merged into pm.breadcrumbWo; 'ล้านบาท' → pm.unitMillion (dash+contracts); 'สร้างใบงาน' schedule tooltip merged into pm.createBtn; PM cycle options shared assets+contracts. (3) OVER-PLACEHOLDER CORRECTED — pm.kpiComplianceSub: source 'เป้าหมาย ≥ 90%' has a HARDCODED literal 90 (not interpolated); removed the extractor's defensive {n}, transcribed verbatim. (4) DROPPED skeleton-only noise: pm.slaInline (contracts inline SLA in a fully-dynamic line). JUDGMENT CALLS documented inline: kept pm.colType (contracts project-type) vs pm.type (wo work-order-type), and pm.legendOverdue vs pm.tabOverdue separate despite byte-identical bytes — different domain concepts/UI roles ported by independent tasks; safer than one key controlling two unrelated screens. Shared PMCalendar/PMUpcoming components render on BOTH schedule and dashboard, so their keys (calDow*, calHint, legend*, upcoming*, toastGenWoAsset) are listed for both screens. Shared openPMExport helper keys (exportModalTitle/Excel/Pdf/Csv/toastDownloading) apply to dash/assets/contracts/wo. Glyph fidelity confirmed against raw lines: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, ≥ U+2265, ✓ U+2713, ฿ U+0E3F, curly quotes U+201C/U+201D (toastProjectCreated, emptyContracts, emptyChecklistHint), leading-space ' (วิดีโอ)' and ' ✓'. ASCII ellipsis '...' (NOT U+2026) confirmed in all SelectOther/search placeholders.
